summary: Finish an HTTP response using Writable.end semantics.

target.notes: Returns receiver; commits pending headers, optionally writes final data, sets writableEnded, and preserves finish/callback timing.

semantics.notes: Returns receiver; commits pending headers, optionally writes final data, sets writableEnded, and preserves finish/callback timing.

caveats: Preserve Node stream/EventEmitter, host ordering, header state, and network/TLS behavior rather than substituting unrelated .NET HTTP defaults.

tests.name: edge semantics
tests.expected_behavior: commits headers and completes empty body
